source: Cancellation probes identify distance reduction trees: opposite large components and unit background

steps.sql: SELECT i.value AS i,j.value AS j,CAST(-VECTOR_DISTANCE('dot',CAST('['+STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN k.value=i.value THEN '1e30' WHEN k.value=j.value THEN '-1e30' ELSE '1' END,',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY k.value)+']' AS vector(3)),CAST('[1,1,1]' AS vector(3))) AS int) AS retained_ones FROM GENERATE_SERIES(0,2) i CROSS JOIN GENERATE_SERIES(0,2) j CROSS JOIN GENERATE_SERIES(0,2) k WHERE i.value<j.value GROUP BY i.value,j.value ORDER BY i.value,j.value;
